name: Grade 9 IIIT Practice: October Week 7 - Risk Map
description: Practice words for Grade 9 third-trimester STEM and cybersecurity work.

words.definition: How likely something is to happen.
words.example: The group rated password sharing as high probability in the risk map.

words.definition: How serious the result would be.
words.example: Data loss had a high impact because it could remove important work.
The risk map placed each problem by probability and impact.
The protection strategy used strong passwords and private sharing settings.

words.definition: Advice about what should be done.
words.example: The recommendation told users to turn on two-factor authentication.

words.definition: A small test showing an idea can work.
words.example: The proof of concept showed that the alert screen could guide users.
